name: AppSDK
purpose: Client-side library for Tesseron app developers. Declares actions, handles local invocations, manages app-side session lifecycle.

name: Gateway
purpose: Server-side bridge between Tesseron apps and MCP agents. Manages WebSocket connections, routes actions to MCP tools, bridges elicitation and sampling.

name: Transport
purpose: Wire-level message delivery across multiple protocols (UDS, WebSocket server, WebSocket client, Pyodide). Protocol-agnostic send/receive/close contract.

name: Protocol
purpose: JSON-RPC dispatch, handshake, capability negotiation, error model, and shared type definitions. Consumed by both AppSDK and Gateway.
